source_label: Chesterfield County GIS school attendance areas, retrieved 2026-10-26
popup_note: The County GIS layers include the new 2026-27 Deep Creek Elementary area but have no per-feature effective-year field. Confirm an address with CCPS Find My School.
rights_access: Chesterfield Open GIS Data terms permit copying, modifying, distributing, and analysis; attribution requested.
overlap_review_note: Equal-area review of 64 source polygons found 15,721.9198 m2 elementary same-level overlap, mainly Old Hundred/Deep Creek (9,561.9 m2), Ettrick/Matoaca (2,826.6 m2), and Matoaca/O.B. Gates (1,264.1 m2). Middle overlap is 457.2 m2 and high overlap is 45.0 m2. The 16,000 m2 cap rejects a larger change. Keep published County geometry and confirm affected addresses with CCPS.
